name: Hereditary Spastic Paraplegia
definition: Group of inherited disorders characterized mainly by progressive lower-limb spasticity and weakness.

investigations.principle: MRI excludes structural causes; genetic testing and metabolic evaluation are subtype-directed.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, tumor or occult-injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific pathway.

amber: Diagnosis should remain neurological/genetic rather than assumed from spasticity alone.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vata-spasticity phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Group of inherited disorders characterized mainly by progressive lower-limb spasticity and weakness.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for rapidly progressive weakness, respiratory/swallowing compromise, major vascular symptoms, suspected malignancy/pathological fracture, severe systemic illness or other listed red flags.
